title: Social Services Regulator publishes 2025–26 Annual Report
body: The Social Services Regulator (SSR) has published its second annual report, covering the 2025–26 financial year. The report highlights the SSR's progress following the Rapid Child Safety Review, with an expansion of the SSR's remit to include delivering the Working with Children Check, NDIS Worker Screening Check, the Reportable Conduct Scheme and taking a greater role in upholding the Child Safe Standards.
verifiedQuote: During this period, there was an expansion of the SSR's remit to include responsibility for delivering the Working with Children Check, NDIS Worker Screening Check, the Reportable Conduct Scheme and taking a greater role in upholding the Child Safe Standards.
correction: The source mentions NDIS Worker Screening Check as part of the SSR's expanded remit, which the draft omitted, and the draft's claim about 'clubs' relevance is not supported by the fetched text which does not mention sporting clubs or sport.

title: WA 'Child Safety is everyone's business' resource hub available
body: The Department of Communities has a 'Child Safety is everyone's business' page with child safe resources for organisations, families and young people, including how organisations can prioritise the safety of children. The 10 National Principles for Child Safe Organisations are not yet embedded into legislation for WA, but the WA Government has committed to introducing a Child Safe Standards Scheme with Ombudsman WA leading its design.
verifiedQuote: The current 10 National Principles are not yet embedded into legislation for Western Australia. The WA Government has committed to introducing a Child Safe Standards Scheme, with Ombudsman WA leading its design.
correction: The source does not support 'launched' (page is dated October 2026, future date likely error), and doesn't mention providing feedback on support needs, so that claim was removed.
